notes.title: Lover Interface demo version 1.0.5 has been updated.
notes.notes:
Lover Interface demo version 1.0.5 has been updated.

This update fixes a display issue with text messages in the English version of the game.

If you are playing in English, please make sure the game is updated to the latest version for the best experience.

notes.title: Lover Interface Demo 1.0.4 Update Notice
notes.notes:
Replaced background music tracks that previously triggered YouTube Content ID claims. You should now be able to record or stream the game freely without copyright warnings or monetization issues. If any problems persist, feel free to report them.  

Fixed typos and omissions in both Traditional Chinese and English text.  

Adjusted several visual assets. 

Thank you to everyone who downloaded the demo and provided feedback — your support is incredibly valuable in improving the overall experience.

If you have any further suggestions or issues with version 1.0.4, feel free to reach out.

Please look forward to the full release.
